record.question: The “Hindu rate of growth” refers to:
options: The rapid economic growth experienced by India after the 1991 economic reforms
The low rate of economic growth experienced by India during the pre- liberalization period
The high growth in agricultural production during the Green Revolution
The rapid expansion of the industrial sector under the Five-Year Plans
